caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a vintage hook with an oval handle. The handle at the top is horizontally oriented, forming an elongated loop that is wider than it is tall. Below the handle, the main shaft of the object extends vertically downward in a straight line, appearing slightly narrower in the middle. The lower end of the object curves into a hook shape facing left and ends bluntly, with a small circular hole near where the hook section begins. The color of the object is mainly a mix of brown and rust tones, suggesting signs of wear and oxidation. The background is a uniform, light beige color without any additional objects or visual elements, allowing the object to be the sole focus of the composition.
title: Log Loading Hook
